clips.title: The story
paras: At Steelgrill's Depot, Milli Featherwhistle keeps Gnomeregan's mechanostriders in motion. She builds and maintains these clockwork mounts for her kin and trusted allies among the exiles.

Outdoors in the biting chill at Steelgrill's Depot, just east of Kharanos, Milli keeps clockwork steeds ready for Gnomeregan's displaced people. Dwarves and night elves favor living mounts, but Milli builds each mechanostrider herself. She calibrates its gears, pistons, and balancing gyros so it can travel across Dun Morogh's snowy crags.

Milli builds her mechanostriders from blueprints first drawn by High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque. She has improved their performance by lightening the chassis and refining the exhaust vents, while keeping to the High Tinker's original designs. Her work carries gnomish ambition forward even in exile.
